blocks.goal: Extract the tag/attribute storage and mutation responsibility from Safelist into a new SafelistTagData class to reduce Safelist size and concentrate tag/attribute logic into a cohesive helper. Keep Safelist's public API by delegating to the new class (compatibility wrappers) and update internal call sites accordingly.

ops.details: Create new class org.jsoup.safety.SafelistTagData in same package. This class encapsulates the previously private fields Set<TagName> tagNames and Map<TagName, Set<AttributeKey>> attributes and implements operations that mutate and query those structures: constructors, void copyTo(SafelistTagData target), boolean removeTag(TagName tag), Set<AttributeKey> allowedAttributes(TagName tag), and the core implementations of addTags/addAttributes/removeAttributes/isSafeTag (renamed addTagsImpl/addAttributesImpl/removeAttributesImpl/isSafeTagImpl). The new class owns initialization of the collections. It does not handle protocols or enforced-attributes logic; it only maintains tag and attribute membership and related data operations. The Safelist class will be updated to hold a private final SafelistTagData tagData field and to replace direct accesses to tagNames/attributes with calls to tagData; public methods addTags/addAttributes/removeAttributes/isSafeTag will remain in Safelist as thin delegation wrappers to preserve API compatibility.

Move private final Set<TagName> tagNames from Safelist into SafelistTagData and remove the field from Safelist. Initialize tagData in Safelist constructors. Update copy-constructor to use tagData.copyTo(...).

Move private final Map<TagName, Set<AttributeKey>> attributes from Safelist into SafelistTagData and remove the field from Safelist. The attributes map is managed by SafelistTagData and exposed via allowedAttributes(TagName) for Safelist queries.

Move the implementation of public Safelist addTags(String... tags) into SafelistTagData as addTagsImpl(String... tags). Replace Safelist.addTags to be a delegating wrapper that calls tagData.addTagsImpl(tags) and then returns this (preserving original API).

Move the implementation of public Safelist addAttributes(String tag, String... attributes) into SafelistTagData as addAttributesImpl(String tag, String... attributes). Replace Safelist.addAttributes with a delegating wrapper to tagData.addAttributesImpl(...).

Move the implementation of public Safelist removeAttributes(String tag, String... attributes) into SafelistTagData as removeAttributesImpl(String tag, String... attributes). Replace Safelist.removeAttributes with a delegating wrapper to tagData.removeAttributesImpl(...).
Move the implementation of public boolean isSafeTag(String tag) into SafelistTagData as isSafeTagImpl(String tag). Replace Safelist.isSafeTag to delegate to tagData.isSafeTagImpl(tag).

Add a copy helper in SafelistTagData: void copyTo(SafelistTagData target). Move the tag/attribute copy logic from Safelist(Safelist copy) into this method and update the Safelist copy constructor to call copy.tagData.copyTo(this.tagData).

Add necessary imports to SafelistTagData (java.util.HashMap, java.util.HashSet, java.util.Map, java.util.Set and org.jsoup.safety.TypedValue.TagName, org.jsoup.safety.TypedValue.AttributeKey) and ensure Safelist still imports what it needs after fields/methods moved.

Update Safelist internal code to use tagData for tag/attribute operations: - Initialize tagData in Safelist() constructor. - In Safelist(Safelist copy) call copy.tagData.copyTo(this.tagData) instead of copying tagNames/attributes directly. - In methods that previously accessed attributes or tagNames directly (e.g. removeTags, isSafeAttribute, shouldAbsUrl helper), replace direct map/set access with tagData.allowedAttributes(TagName) or tagData.removeTag(TagName) as appropriate. Keep public Safelist methods addTags/addAttributes/removeAttributes/isSafeTag as delegating wrappers calling tagData implementations and returning this or boolean as before.
